1st Viscount Stratford de Redcliffe, ambassador

He married, secondly, Eliza Charlotte Alexander (d. 25 Nov 1882) He was ambassador to Constantinople 1825-9 and 1841-58.

He was created a viscount in 1852.

He was uncle to Emma (Barnett) Butler and first cousin once removed to Rev. W. J.

Butler [Complete Peerage; A.J.

Butler]
